verdict.rationale: VPM documents same-day scanning of served legal documents via its registered-agent service and generic automation rules for mail handling, which could be used to route or alert on legal mail, but there is no evidence of a dedicated flagging/prioritization feature that specifically tags IRS notices, state filings, or service of process as high-priority so deadlines aren't missed. missing for 10: dedicated compliance-deadline alerting/flagging feature, sender-type classification (IRS/state/legal), deadline-tracking or reminder system.
